title: Dow Jones| Nasdaq | US Stock Market Today | Live: US stocks edge higher despite semiconductor rout; Fed meet in focus - The Economic Times
text:
Dow Jones Today | US Stock Market Live: US stocks traded ​higher on Tuesday despite mirroring ​a cautious mood across global markets toward ‌AI ⁠chip stocks ⁠on concerns about ​hefty corporate spending and rising Chinese ​competition, ahead of earnings from ​some of ⁠the biggest companies ‌on ​Wall ​Street.

The Federal Reserve began a two-day policy meeting Tuesday, with officials expected to leave interest rates unchanged as concerns mount over inflation fueled by the Iran war. The decision, followed by Fed Chair Kevin Warsh’s press conference, is due Wednesday at 2 p.m. ET.
